scope: Only OKC_WGS && OKC_WGSFINSS: eight existing cross-warp sum owners store the exact route coefficient in their existing shared slots; consumers replace the duplicate expression with a shared load.
independent_source_findings: S.pos is a signed-short route-position table, assigned a nonnegative local row or -1 for every input entry and published by the existing routing CTA barrier. It is not mutated during finalization.
All 512 consumer threads own the same token and load identical qv[0..7]; owner S.pos[tk*8+tid]>=0 is exactly the consumer live-route predicate for tid=sl.
red[0..127] contains 16-warps by 8-route partials. Owners read all of those before writing distinct red[128..135]; these regions do not alias.

Preserve the exact 16-add tsum reduction order, identical float constants, rsqrtf and topk-weight multiplication. The FP32 shared store/reload of tsum is replaced by a FP32 store/reload of the coefficient; no precision or algebraic reassociation is requested.

The existing named CTA_SYNC barrier has 512 participants and a compiler memory clobber. It publishes all eight coefficient stores before any consumer reads; the existing token-tail barrier prevents next-token shared reuse while consumers remain.
The two producer warps return through their inherited paths and do not participate in these consumer-only barriers. No new barrier or ring lifetime is introduced.
Invalid or remote owners write zero without reading their topk weight. Consumers retain qv guards, all route FMA order, cached y values, output columns and BF16 conversions.
HD==NT*8 fixes exactly4096 columns and512 consumer threads. The same finalizer applies to both BIG templates and all MAIN NTT/job distributions; non-WGS/WGSFINSS0 branches remain unchanged.

Token iteration and MMAX384 outer chunking remain exact. At actual grid132, M128 uses at most one token per CTA; M256/384 can reuse a CTA for more tokens. The plan's M128 wording is not an algorithm defect.
A token with no local routes retains zero output if inherited earlier phases reach the finalizer. This does not establish arbitrary global-zero-job support.

removal_and_costs.logical_scalar_evaluations_per_token: 512*R -> R, where0<=R<=8 is local route count
removal_and_costs.direct_simt_model: 16*R warp expression executions -> one masked owner-warp expression whenR>0; not measured SASS
removal_and_costs.unchanged: Eight shared stores, per-consumer coefficient loads, all ybuf reads, cached values, route sums and output stores
removal_and_costs.added: Eight owner S.pos shared reads and owner-path scalar latency before existing publication barrier
removal_and_costs.unknown: Actual compiler allocation, instruction sequence, register impact and exposed performance; no HBM savings claim

proof_requirements: Deterministic build and complete source restoration of the scoped owner/consumer delta plus namespace, approved resource helper and verbosity.
Non-WGS preprocessing/control paths unchanged, both BIG pointers resource-checked with unchanged576 threads and231168 dynamic bytes.

Actual-snippet small mask/owner/slot test: all256 route masks, one/eight/no-local routes, valid row indices, repeated token iterations and short chunks; preserve reduction/consumer order and barrier placement.
Do not introduce a full MMA/lifetime simulator or claim host rsqrt is a GPU oracle.
Resource API failures must propagate; register/local data is evidence, not an arbitrary rejection threshold.
Freeze candidate and require independent source review plus root CPU rerun before one official check.

fixed_pre_result_gate.promotion: A passing screen permits separately reviewed decoder port only; public promotion also requires actual aggregate improvement.

limitations: This is plan/source feasibility, not CUDA compilation, numerical GPU proof or performance evidence.
Both paths retain parent --use_fast_math flags. Actual contraction/rsqrt lowering still requires official correctness; no host mathematical implementation substitutes for it.
No existing-tail latency is claimed to be entirely removable; no prior compiler-serialization claim is used.
